verification_notes: Audited from first principles: Incompressible solid volume conservation V = A*l = constant under recasting and stretching verified. Geometric scaling relations R = rho*l^2/V = (rho*V)/(pi^2*r^4) rigorously checked. Resistance scales as R proportional to l^2 and R proportional to r^-4 (or d^-4). Dimensional analysis confirmed: [rho*l^2/V] = (Ohm*m)*(m^2)/(m^3) = Ohms; [rho*V/(pi^2*r^4)] = (Ohm*m)*(m^3)/(m^4) = Ohms. Limiting cases verified: r_2 = r_1 yields R_2 = R_1; r -> 0 yields R -> infinity; r -> infinity yields R -> 0. Assumptions audited: Constant density, mass conservation, isothermal conditions (constant rho), uniform circular cross-section. Claim traces to curriculum node and formula-curr-recasting-volume verified.
